data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 雨后水洼的小跳跃
data.description: 雨刚停，十香穿橙色雨衣和背带长裤，轻轻迈跳过小水洼，在两只雨靴落地后开心地抬起手。她回头看水面还在扩散的涟漪，长发跟着转身扬起，像发现新游戏般高兴。
data.action: 跳过水洼稳稳落地，回头开心看着涟漪。
data.camera: full body, eye level, nearby environmental portrait
data.promptProse: Both yellow rain boots land beyond the puddle as Tohka raises her hands in delight and turns back to inspect the widening ripples. Her orange rain jacket covers full-length navy dungarees, with dark-purple hair swinging around her open smile. Keep one continuous pose at eye level in the full-body view, pavement receding behind. Soft after-rain daylight brightens the jacket and wet ground, with contact shadows beneath her grounded boots.
